name: Fred
source:
Fred is the main character's father. He's been missing for fifteen years after a bad deal went south, leading to his being arrested. He wants to be reunited with his family more than anything else and is willing to do whatever it takes to do so.

On top of that, Fred seeks revenge against the person he believes to be truly responsible for his fate and will do anything to ensure that the truth about his past is revealed and that the guilty parties are punished.
